_about: Swimming, diving and salvage (sea step 5b). Director: an empty stamina bar = DROWNING DAMAGE until a ladder, a rope or the shore; salvage = BOTH fixed hand-placed spots per region (bubbles show them; each find fills that region's logbook set, a full set pays a reward) AND random small finds on any dive deep enough; the rope = F at the rail. swim: speed m/s, sprint multiplier, float = how far the body's feet hang under the surface when floating, wade = feet this deep under the surface = swimming, max_depth = deepest dive, stamina drain per second (tread = still, move, under = head under water, sprint multiplier), storm_drain = extra drain per metre of swell above 1, regen per second out of the water, drown = share of max health lost per second at empty stamina, stamina_per_agility = more stamina per Agility level, ladder_reach / climb_seconds = the rope ladders, rope_reach / rope_grab / haul_seconds / rope_seconds = the thrown rope. dive: min_depth = how deep the head must be for random finds, random_every seconds down there for one roll at random_chance, xp: Agility xp per 10 s under water, per random find, per spot find. sets: per region, finds (ids; names and lines in data/sea/writing/salvage.txt), reward chips + Agility xp. spots: sea coordinates, depth of the sea bed there, model. trinkets: the random finds (weights). ALL NUMBERS, NAMES AND PLACES ARE MY PLACEHOLDERS. Spots with "plan" instead of "find" hold a ship's plan for the shipyard (sea step 5c, director: side ships from FOUND PLANS: raft in region 1, longboat in region 4, junk in region 6); the plan goes into the bag and the spot stops bubbling once you have it. Spots with "riddle" (sea step 13d) are HIDDEN caches: no bubbles, not takeable, not in rumours, until this player has read that riddle from a message in a bottle (logbook found "riddle:<id>").
